## Episode Thesis

This is a political episode of Sparpodden ahead of the 2026 Swedish election, featuring Social Democrat economic policy spokesperson Mikael Damberg. It covers Trump-era trade uncertainty, Europe falling behind in AI, data-centre and energy policy, youth unemployment, the S proposal to cut the ISK tax discount for savings over SEK 3m, interest deductions on securities-backed loans, and housing construction. No investment views on individual stocks are given; companies come up only as examples in the AI and industrial-policy discussion.
